user.title: Connect to your Sophos Firewall
user.description: Enable SNMP on the firewall first: Administration › SNMP (add an agent and a v1/v2c community or a v3 user that allows this Home Assistant's IP), and tick SNMP under Administration › Device access for the zone Home Assistant is in.

community.title: SNMP community
community.description: Community configured on {host} under Administration › SNMP.

v3.title: SNMPv3 user
v3.description: SNMPv3 user configured on {host} under Administration › SNMP. Keys must be at least 8 characters.

error.cannot_connect: No SNMP response. Check the IP, that SNMP is ticked under Device access for HA's zone, that the community/user matches, and that the SNMP agent's allowed hosts include Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: The firewall rejected the SNMPv3 credentials (user, password or algorithm mismatch).
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Monitored items

system.title: System & resources
system.description: Tick the items to monitor; untick to remove their entities. Current values are shown next to each item.

services.title: Services
services.description: Each selected service becomes a sensor showing running / stopped / dead / untouched etc. "Untouched" usually means the feature isn't configured.

licenses.title: Licenses & subscriptions
licenses.description: Each selected license becomes a sensor with its subscription status; the expiry date and days remaining are attributes.

hardware.title: Hardware sensors
hardware.description: Temperatures, fans and power supplies are reported by XGS appliances on SFOS 22 and later.

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.description: Choose the interfaces to monitor, then which metrics to create for each of them. Each interface gets its own device. This firewall reports {hc} traffic counters.

custom_add.title: Add a custom OID
custom_add.description: Monitor any OID the firewall exposes. Use "rate" for counters to get a per-second value (multiplied by the scale, e.g. 0.000008 turns bytes/s into Mbit/s). Last value read: {value}

error.invalid_oid: Enter a numeric OID such as 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0.
error.oid_no_value: The firewall returned no value for this OID. Tick "Add without testing" to add it anyway.
error.not_numeric: This OID returns text; choose the "text" value type.
